routines.title: Daily timing changes and skipped meals

protocol.weighting: Equal routine and patient weight; all variants of an identity stay in its split.
candidateModels: clock-free HistGradientBoosting:160 iterations,31 leaves,.07 learning rate,60 minimum leaf,10 L2,63 bins; absolute-error regression
protocol.regressionSelection: Lowest selection-patient +120-minute MAE, averaged equally over six routines.
protocol.classificationSelection: Lowest uncalibrated selection-patient Brier score, reported with AUROC/AP/recall/precision; independent of regression selection.
protocol.calibration: Separate calibration identities only: Platt mapping, 90th absolute residual quantiles, highest .01-grid alert threshold with >=80% calibration recall.
protocol.finalLock: No final identity is generated until chosen models, preprocessing, calibration, interval widths and threshold are exported and SHA-256 recorded.
protocol.finalInterpretation: Fresh-identity generalization within a declared six-routine mixture. Routine families appear in training; this is not unseen-routine or clinical validation.
limitations: The simulator and candidate features were designed after examining v1 failures; final IDs are fresh but model development is not independent of simulator design.
Previous-day horizon-aligned readings assume some recurrence; future unannounced meals remain unpredictable.
HR includes a contemporaneous synthetic meal response. No future meal annotation or latent simulator state is a predictor.

alertPolicy.selection: Highest 0.01-grid threshold achieving >=80% recall on separate calibration identities

limitations: The simulator and candidate features were designed after examining v1 failures; final IDs are fresh but model development is not independent of simulator design.
Previous-day horizon-aligned readings assume some recurrence; future unannounced meals remain unpredictable.
HR includes a contemporaneous synthetic meal response. No future meal annotation or latent simulator state is a predictor.
All outcomes are synthetic; no external or clinical accuracy is demonstrated.
Routine families are present in augmented training. Fresh identities are held out; these are not unseen routine families.
Repeated windows and routine variants are correlated; uncertainty resamples identities, keeping variants paired.
The calibration residual band is marginal and can be wider than v1; report width and per-routine coverage together.
The event threshold trades recall for false positives. Future unpredictable meals set a ceiling on advance prediction.
Counterfactual controls remain illustrative arithmetic; no treatment effects are learned.
